I use this optional notebook to explore the frozen outputs. The complete
reproduction pipeline is in the R scripts; rendering this notebook is optional
and requires `rmarkdown` and `knitr` in addition to the core dependencies.

```{r}
root <- if (basename(getwd()) == "notebooks") dirname(getwd()) else getwd()
.libPaths(c(file.path(root, ".R-library"), .libPaths()))
summary <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(root, "results", "summary.json"))
summary$audit
```

```{r}
read.csv(file.path(root, "results", "did_specifications.csv"))
read.csv(file.path(root, "results", "rematch_leakage_metrics.csv"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "report", "figures", "04_did_sensitivity.png"))
```

I interpret these comparisons as measured rating changes. Their causal interpretation
depends on untreated parallel trends, comparator spillovers, and stable observation.
